integrity.outside_scope: No extrapolation to n>15, weighted or cyclic graphs, or observed real-world cascades.
integrity.source_provenance: First motivating public source is an April 19, 2016 dated original working paper; other references are supporting published literature.

scientific_limitations: The sharp cutoff is established for finite simple unweighted trees, independent homogeneous link reliability, and expected spread from one seed; no conclusion is given for general graphs or heterogeneous propagation.
The finite exact census requires the included nonisomorphic-tree generator and symbolic computation dependencies; source code is provided for replay.
An accessible abstract but not the full text of the 2026 study of decay-unstable trees could be checked; stronger undiscovered coverage cannot be excluded.
No independent audit or independent validation has occurred.
title: Fifteen vertices are necessary and sufficient for reentrant optimal information seeding on trees
